name: Krishanveer Forge Limited
about: Krishanveer Forge Limited manufactures and sells open die forging products in India and internationally. The company offers plain carbon steels, alloy steels and stainless steels, and shape components; and shafts, square and rectangular section, blanks, rings, and hollow products. It serves its products to oil and gas, infrastructure, power transmission, mining and construction, gear box manufacturing, steel plants, cement, sugar mills, infrastructure, windmill, and other sectors. The company was formerly known as Rajkumar Forge Limited and changed its name to Krishanveer Forge Limited in August 2022. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Pune, India. Krishanveer Forge Limited operates as a subsidiary of Western India Forgings Pvt. Limited.
